description: Tell the FilmLab team about a bug or a missing feature — it reaches the people who can fix it, the chat does not. Use art 'fehler' when a tool returned something wrong, failed without a clear reason, or contradicted its own description; 'wunsch' when a step you needed does not exist. Write what you called, what you expected and what came back; put ids, arguments and the error text into `kontext` (no secrets, no personal data of third parties). One report per problem. Do not report a refused request that was correct (e.g. 'Project not found' for someone else's project). Needs an account. Free.

art.description: fehler = something is broken; wunsch = something is missing

kontext.description: Machine-readable details: ids, arguments, error text. Max ~8000 characters as JSON

project_id.description: Your project it happened in (only your own projects are accepted)

text.description: What you called, what you expected, what happened — in a few sentences

titel.description: One line, e.g. 'lab_capture: black frame for an image clip'

werkzeug.description: The tool it is about, e.g. 'lab_timeline_apply'

name: lab_feedback
title: Report a Bug or Wish
